assumptions: The parameter source derived_release/v1 takes every edge sign and strength from a parameter set derived from the official release under the rules with hash 9cb5aa45c96c1242a642257ab86fca7a7ae24df91159deeb3e48b90d10738ee1, read from the file with SHA-256 c4db0f3f93390b66c417cee2a96d805179e4fb178678615ec537260710c58c77. The signs are rule-derived from predicted per-T-bar transmitter probabilities, not measured synaptic actions, and the rule that maps a transmitter to a sign is an explicit assumption recorded in that file's derivation report.

Edges whose sign the rules left unknown were handled by the declared policy "exclude": 2754056 of 25563197 edges were unknown (13636628 positive, 9172513 negative), and under this policy an unknown edge contributes weight zero, so it was excluded from the run. No sign was guessed and no default was substituted.
Every derived strength was multiplied by the declared weight_scale 21.6, which is an engineering choice of units and not a measured synaptic conductance.
bias, log_tau and theta_raw are still uniform engineering values from the protocol: the release carries no per-neuron time constant or threshold and none was derived here.
Every edge delay is zero. The release carries no conduction delay and none was invented.
Node indices, edge order and raw weights come from the graph store; the run changes nothing about the wiring.

Local plasticity was enabled on 25563197 of 25563197 edges under the rule "hebbian_rate" with decay_e 0.5, decay_p 0.5, plastic_max 0.01 and w_min 0.0001; the learning gate of each step is gate_scale 1 times channel 1 of the declared stimulus. The step count, the graph and the parameters are unchanged; only the wall clock is, and the cost grows with the step count, not with the enabled edge count.

reproduction: Every cell is one independent run of the same protocol. Cell 0 is reproduced by simulate run with this store, the run protocol and, for the derived source, the same parameter set file. A null model cell is reproduced by rebuilding its variant from the same store with the recorded kind, seed and pcg generator and then running that protocol; the recorded topology_hash and parameter_hash must match before the numbers are compared. The report states metric values, thresholds declared before the run and the position of the original inside the null model distribution. It makes no claim about behaviour. The learning variants run on the original wiring: original is the same protocol with the plasticity block removed, plastic runs the block as declared, and learned_then_frozen reruns the same stimulus with the weights fixed at base plus the fast changes the plastic cell ended with and no further update. Each cell's plasticity block reports the rule, the enabled edges, the gate channel, both clamp counts and the Euclidean norm of the fast changes before and after the run.
